note: Targets are TARGETs set by the plan, not forecasts. Relative targets refer to the dated baseline. Absolute targets are re-set on 2026-11-02.

kpis.name: Weekly Returning Members (WRM) — North Star
kpis.definition: Accounts with at least one meaningful action in a rolling 7-day window: shelf change, rating, comment, list edit, reminder set, Analyzer run tied to an account, Discord linked-XP event.
kpis.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) over the union of user_games.updated_at, game_ratings, comments, game_lists/game_list_items, reminder changes (user_games.notify_on_release), user_wow_characters activity and Discord XP rows in the reward ledger, for the 7 days ending Sunday 23:59 CET (query Q-01).
kpis.source: Production DB (read replica or read-only query)

baseline.note: Proxy: of 55 members, 45 had zero XP (code comment, before 31 Aug 2026) [R01]. Anonymous WoW analyses (wow_analyses has no user_id) cannot count.

kpis.name: Traffic — human sessions per week
kpis.definition: Sessions (distinct GA session ids) from non-bot hits in the first-party collector, per ISO week.
kpis.formula: SUM(analytics_daily.sessions) for the ISO week (Q-02). Visitor counts are per-day hashes; never add them up as 'unique visitors'.

baseline.value: UNKNOWN — run Q-02 for W39 (21–27 Sep)
baseline.note: First full week after the Google CMP change of 20 Sep; earlier weeks are not comparable [README §19].

kpis.name: Organic search clicks
kpis.definition: Google Search clicks (web search type) per day, 7-day average.
kpis.formula: GSC Performance > Search results > clicks / 7, by week; split brand vs non-brand by query filter 'techplay'.

baseline.note: About 100 a day before the Cloudflare 403 incident of 17 Aug 2026 [R03, README §12].

kpis.name: Google Discover clicks
kpis.definition: Clicks from Google Discover per week.
kpis.formula: GSC Performance > Discover > clicks, weekly. If the report shows no data, record 'below reporting threshold'.

baseline.value: UNKNOWN — no GSC access in research
baseline.note: Discover readiness partly met (max-image-preview:large present; some OG images multi-MB) [R03 §12].

targets.2026-10-31: TARGET Discover report shows data (any clicks)
targets.2026-11-30: TARGET ≥ 3 articles with ≥ 100 Discover clicks each in November
targets.2026-12-31: TARGET Discover ≥ 20% of all Google clicks in December

kpis.name: Google News visibility
kpis.definition: Whether TechPlay articles appear in Google News for topics it covered, plus News clicks where GSC reports them.
kpis.formula: Monthly probe: 16 own-topic Google News RSS searches (R03 method) → count of probes returning a TechPlay article; GSC 'News' search type clicks if available.
kpis.source: Google News RSS probe (manual, ED); GSC

baseline.note: site:techplay.gg News feed returned 99 game-database pages and 1 article [R02, R03].

targets.2026-10-31: TARGET 0 game pages in the site: News feed (D-022)
targets.2026-11-30: TARGET ≥ 2 of 16 probes return a TechPlay article

kpis.name: Direct sessions
kpis.definition: Sessions whose landing hit has no referrer and no UTM.
kpis.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT session) from analytics_events where the session's first hit has referrer_host IS NULL and (after D-008) utm_source IS NULL, is_bot = false (Q-03, raw table, 90-day window).

baseline.note: Direct is not in analytics_daily_breakdowns (the referrer breakdown skips empty values); it must be read from raw rows.

kpis.name: Social referral sessions
kpis.definition: Sessions arriving from social platforms: referrer_host in the social host list, or utm_medium in (organic-social, paid-social, community) after D-008.
kpis.formula: COUNT(DISTINCT session) per week, by platform (Q-04). Paid-social reported separately.

baseline.note: Social accounts: Discord 160, YouTube 20 subscribers, X/Facebook/Instagram counts unverified [R02].

kpis.name: Verified registrations
kpis.definition: New accounts that reached A1 Reachable (email verified or social sign-up) in the period.
kpis.formula: COUNT(users) WHERE created_at in period AND email_verified_at IS NOT NULL (Q-05), split by signup method and from= (after D-008).
kpis.source: Production DB (users); GA4 registration_complete for consented attribution

baseline.note: 50 of 55 confirmed email (code comment, before 31 Aug) [R01, R12].

kpis.name: Activation (A2 Shelved)
kpis.definition: Share of a registration cohort that links a platform OR has ≥ 3 shelf items within 7 days of sign-up (spine §3, R11 §6); plus the cumulative count of A2 members.
kpis.formula: A2 ÷ A0 for each weekly cohort, read 7 days after the cohort closes (Q-06); cumulative A2 members.

baseline.note: Stricter reading: 3 of 55 added a game and 2 linked a platform (before 31 Aug) [R12]. A2 itself: UNKNOWN until Q-06 runs.

targets.2026-12-31: TARGET cohort A2 ≥ 40%; 100 A2 members (Founding 100, C68)

kpis.name: Newsletter verified subscribers
kpis.definition: Double-opt-in subscribers who asked (source = form), verified, active, not suppressed.
kpis.formula: COUNT(newsletter_subscribers) WHERE source = 'form' AND email_verified_at IS NOT NULL AND is_active (Q-07); net new = this week minus last week.

baseline.note: Count was never published; 'thousands of fans' copy is unverified [R11, R20]. Rows with source = 'account' are not subscribers.

kpis.name: Discord members
kpis.definition: Members in the TechPlay.gg Discord server.
kpis.formula: Bot guild.memberCount at Monday 09:00; joins by invite code from D-011.

baseline.note: A code comment gives 153 (undated) [R01]; use the API figure.

kpis.name: Returning users
kpis.definition: Primary: returning members = accounts active on ≥ 2 distinct days in the week (last_seen_at / action dates). Secondary: GA4 returning users (consented visitors only, directional).
kpis.formula: Q-08 on accounts; GA4 Explore 'new vs returning' for the consented sample. The first-party collector cannot answer this: the visitor hash is re-salted nightly [README §19].

baseline.note: No returning-visitor count exists anywhere today [R12, R16 §4].

kpis.name: Pages per session
kpis.definition: Page views per session.
kpis.formula: SUM(pageviews) ÷ SUM(sessions) from analytics_daily (Q-02); segment by landing type (article, game, hub) from raw rows.
kpis.source: First-party collector; GA4 views per session (consented) as a cross-check

baseline.note: Sessions exist only for hits with a GA session id; check the share of hits without one (Q-09).

kpis.name: Member retention D7 / D30
kpis.definition: Share of A2 members who perform a meaningful action on day 7 (days 6–8) and day 30 (days 28–32) after sign-up.
kpis.formula: Cohort query Q-10 over the WRM action union.

baseline.note: Cohorts are tiny; report counts next to percentages.

kpis.name: Approved comments
kpis.definition: Comments with status = approved created in the week, and the number of distinct commenters.
kpis.formula: COUNT(comments) WHERE status = 'approved' by created_at week; COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) (Q-11).

baseline.note: 7 of 55 members had commented (before 31 Aug) [R12].

kpis.name: Social follower growth
kpis.definition: Net new followers per platform per week (X, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, LinkedIn).
kpis.formula: Follower count Monday minus previous Monday, typed into the sheet by SC from each platform's own page.

baseline.value: YouTube 20 subscribers; others UNVERIFIED — SC records all on 28 Sep
baseline.note: Facebook and Instagram counts sit behind login walls; TikTok, Bluesky, LinkedIn accounts not found [R02].

targets.2026-10-31: TARGET YouTube 40–60; every active platform shows net growth in ≥ 3 of 5 weeks

kpis.name: Video views
kpis.definition: Views of TechPlay short and long videos per week, all platforms, and the median 7-day views per video.
kpis.formula: Sum of platform-reported views for videos published since 5 Oct; median of 7-day views per video; utm sessions per 1,000 views.
kpis.source: Platform analytics (TikTok, YouTube Studio, Instagram, Facebook); first-party utm sessions

baseline.note: YouTube channel joined 9 Feb 2026, 20 subscribers, no uploads visible [R02].

targets.2026-10-31: TARGET ≥ 12 videos published; October median recorded as baseline
targets.2026-12-31: TARGET median 7-day views ≥ 3× October median; ≥ 1 session per 500 views

kpis.name: Campaign CAC (paid)
kpis.definition: Paid spend per activated (A2) member attributed to a paid campaign.
kpis.formula: Spend in period ÷ A2 members whose users.signup_utm_medium in (cpc, paid-social) (D-008). Reported per campaign (C56, C57, C58).
kpis.source: Ad platform spend exports; production DB

baseline.value: Not applicable — no paid spend before 19 Oct
baseline.note: No ad pixel installed; collector drops UTMs today [R16].

targets.2026-10-31: TARGET ≤ $25 per A2 member (ESTIMATE basis: $10 per verified registration ÷ 40% A2)
targets.2026-11-30: TARGET ≤ $25 per A2 member; stop any campaign above $60

kpis.name: Cost per verified registration
kpis.definition: Paid spend per verified registration (A1) attributed to paid; companion costs per newsletter_verified and per Discord join.
kpis.formula: Spend ÷ verified registrations with paid signup UTM; spend ÷ newsletter_verified with paid UTM; spend ÷ discord_join by paid invite code.
kpis.source: Ad platform exports; production DB; D-011 join log

baseline.value: Not applicable — no paid spend before 19 Oct
baseline.note: R16 §3: worth a second quarter under ~$10, stop above ~$25; newsletter < $8 (T9); Discord join < $3 (T4).

targets.2026-10-31: TARGET ≤ $10 per verified registration (C56 only running)
targets.2026-11-30: TARGET ≤ $10; ≤ $8 per newsletter_verified; ≤ $3 per Discord join

kpis.name: Email complaint rate (guardrail)
kpis.definition: Spam complaints per delivered email, per send.
kpis.formula: Complaints ÷ delivered for each campaign and automated stream.
kpis.source: Mail desk (mail_campaigns); provider feedback where available

baseline.value: UNKNOWN — complaints are not ingested (MailSuppression never records them) [R01 B.12]
baseline.note: Self-hosted sender without Gmail reputation; DNS/SMTP changes need approval [R20].

kpis.name: Unsubscribe rate (guardrail)
kpis.definition: Unsubscribes per delivered email, per send.
kpis.formula: Unsubscribes attributed to a send ÷ delivered.

baseline.note: Unsubscribe links are deliberately untracked; count via token use [R20].

kpis.name: Giveaway-only account share (guardrail)
kpis.definition: Share of accounts created through a giveaway that, 14 days later, have no action other than giveaway entry and tasks.
kpis.formula: Accounts with from=giveaway (D-008) and no WRM action 14 days after creation ÷ all from=giveaway accounts (Q-12).

baseline.value: UNKNOWN; 21 of 55 members had entered a giveaway (before 31 Aug)
baseline.note: 25-GIVEAWAYS sets ≤ 60% at close; paid giveaway traffic stops above 70% [R16 T13].

kpis.name: Comment moderation queue time (guardrail)
kpis.definition: Median and maximum hours from comment_created to approval or rejection for pending comments.
kpis.formula: comments.updated_at − created_at where status moved from pending (Q-11b); needs an approved_at timestamp to be exact.

baseline.note: First three comments of every new member are held [R11 §1.3].

kpis.name: Reminders set
kpis.definition: Release reminders switched on per week (members and, after D-016, guests who registered through the modal).
kpis.formula: COUNT(user_games) WHERE notify_on_release switched on in the week (Q-13; needs an audit timestamp or the reminder_set event log).

baseline.note: Reminders exist but are delivered to the bell only [R12].

kpis.name: Alert delivered → visit rate
kpis.definition: Share of delivered release-day, price-drop and personalised alerts (email, Discord DM, push) followed by a click-through within 24 hours.
kpis.formula: alert_clicked ÷ reminder_delivered per channel and alert type.
kpis.source: Mail click tracking; bot DM log; D-019 push log

baseline.value: Not applicable — no alert leaves the site before C43 (19 Oct)
baseline.note: 20 of 22 notification types are bell-only [R01].

kpis.name: Index health of the priority set
kpis.definition: Share of priority URLs (articles, hubs, enriched game pages) that Google reports as indexed; Googlebot requests per day.
kpis.formula: GSC Pages report filtered to the priority sitemaps; GSC crawl stats requests/day.

baseline.value: 56,355 indexed / 338,358 not; ~290 Googlebot requests/day (77 game pages)
baseline.note: The total indexed count is not a goal; the priority set is [R03 §9].

targets.2026-10-31: TARGET ≥ 80% of articles published since 28 Sep indexed
targets.2026-12-31: TARGET ≥ 90% of priority set indexed; crawl requests ≥ 2× 290/day

kpis.name: Measurement health: EEA consent rate and attribution coverage
kpis.definition: EEA/UK/CH share of visitors with analytics consent granted; share of registrations with a from/UTM value; share of Discord joins attributed to an invite code.
kpis.formula: Consented visitors ÷ visitors for EEA countries (collector consent column, Q-14); registrations with signup_from ÷ registrations; attributed joins ÷ joins.
kpis.source: First-party collector; production DB; D-011 join log

baseline.note: If EEA consent stays under 30%, EEA paid tests are read on first-party data only [R16 §4].

targets.2026-10-31: REPORT only; attribution coverage ≥ 90% of registrations
